name: Leaden heart
description: The find that makes the ball heavy: the muck is the same muck, and there is a stone at the middle of it. Drawn as the ball from above with a split opened down the right of it — packed brown outside, and through the gap a violet core lit where a facet catches, with the muck's own rim of ink still round the whole thing so it reads as one object rather than as a gem on a lump. Every other weapon relic puts the weapon's own material on the plate; this one puts something that is not the weapon *inside* it, which is the only honest picture of a find whose whole effect is weight the ball did not have. Legibility pass: the muck was packed in timber's dark end and the core in carapace's, so at 26px the split read as a dark patch on a dark ball. Both went a step up; the sparks were already the brightest thing here and did not move.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
